name: cortico-world-fatfish
description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话让它帮你干活写代码，宠物回复时用内置语音包读出声（朗读支持 Windows 与 macOS）。桥接这半边需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件（coopanion-connector-dsh）才会连；不会装就看源码仓库的说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。固定会话需 DSH 侧插件 coopanion-connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.4（仅 GitHub 分发，未上 npm）。默认关闭 relayPerson 与 relayPet 两个自动转发开关；DSH 侧插件请升到 v0.2.9 修复 CSWSH 安全漏洞。/ Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work — writing code for you — and hear the pet's replies read aloud with built-in voices (Windows and macOS). The bridge half needs the DSH Host extension first; if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it. Pinning a session needs the DSH host extension ≥ 0.2.4 (GitHub only, not on npm). Both relayPerson and relayPet are off by default. UPGRADE the DSH host plugin to v0.2.9 for a CSWSH security fix.
author: blacksunshy

zh.description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话，让它帮你干活、写代码；宠物回复你的时候用内置语音包读出声（朗读支持 Windows 与 macOS）。桥接需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件才会连——不会装就看源码仓库说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。固定会话需 Host 插件 coopanion-connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.4（仅 GitHub 分发，未上 npm）。默认关闭「转发人物的话」和「转发桌宠的话」两个开关；如果你同时用 DSH 侧插件，请把它升到 v0.2.9 修复 CSWSH 安全漏洞。

en.description: Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work and writes code for you, and hear the pet's replies read aloud with built-in voices (Windows and macOS). The bridge needs the DSH Host extension installed first — if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it. Pinning a session needs the DSH host extension coopanion-connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.4 (GitHub only, not on npm). Both relayPerson and relayPet are off by default. UPGRADE the DSH host plugin to v0.2.9 for a CSWSH security fix.
